snowpile.title: Snow Pile Analysis

lastPage.title: Information
lastPage.text: The snow pile analysis is a tool that allows users to create a snow pile in a 3D scene. It enables melt analysis by taking weather conditions into account and calculates the amount of meltwater resulting from the melting of the snow pile. The analysis considers various factors such as the height of the snow pile, the date of the analysis, and the environmental conditions. The results are presented in the form of diagrams and tables that show the melt rate and other relevant information. Users can also export the results as a PDF for further analysis or reporting.
